name: 实现 ProjectService (part 2)
description:
实现 ProjectService 服务方法: update_project, delete_project, switch_project
  - update_project: (project_id: uuid, req: ProjectUpdateRequest, actor: str) -> Project pre=project_id 对应项目存在且 deleted_at IS NULL；若更新 name，新名称不得与已有活跃项目冲
  - delete_project: (project_id: uuid, actor: str) -> None pre=project_id 对应项目存在且 deleted_at IS NULL；该项目的所有部署记录状态均为 success
  - switch_project: (project_id: uuid) -> ProjectSwitchResponse pre=project_id 对应项目存在且 deleted_at IS NULL
